target_customer: Biotech and medical device companies that need FDA submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, 510(k), De Novo, PMA and others)
problem: FDA regulatory consulting is billed hourly, slow and expensive. Panacea sells fixed, milestone-based fees and pairs ex-FDA consultants with an AI platform.
business_model: Services-led regulatory consulting with fixed outcome-based pricing, paid at milestones, augmented by in-house AI tooling

founders.name: Haris Javed-Akhtar
founders.background_notes: Medical doctor. Source: YC company page.

founders.name: Yaman Ziadeh
education: University of Illinois Chicago, MS in AI
previous_startups: Baqi (co-founded and bootstrapped, outcome not stated)

competitors.name: Innolitics
competitors.what: Engineering and regulatory consulting firm focused on AI-enabled medical device software, with a fast 510(k) service

competitors.name: ClemTech RAi
competitors.what: Software that automates 510(k) drafting, QMS setup and regulatory strategy, with a startup program

competitors.name: i-GENTIC AI
competitors.what: Suite of AI agents for medtech FDA bottlenecks and 510(k) success

technical_complexity.rationale: The edge is domain expertise from ex-FDA reviewers; the AI layer is document drafting and workflow tooling on top of existing models, not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Differentiation rests on recruiting experienced ex-FDA consultants and a fixed-price offer. Competitors already sell AI-assisted regulatory work, and pricing models are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to tell; the company is a Spring 2026 YC company and no incumbent response was found.

market_need_then: Biotech and device startups face high hourly consulting bills and long timelines for FDA filings; the company's pitch targets fixed cost and speed. Demand evidence is the company's testimonial from one client and its stated track record, not independent data.

branding.domain_note: Uses withpanacea.com rather than panacea.com; many unrelated companies use the name Panacea.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, outcome-focused: fixed fees, pay at milestones.

branding.brand_signature: Pay only when milestones are complete

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the name is a common word shared with several unrelated companies, so search confusion is likely.

outcome_analysis: Panacea is an active Spring 2026 YC company, so there is no outcome yet. Its path depends on whether fixed-price, milestone billing with ex-FDA experts can scale beyond a services business. The founder-market fit of a physician CEO and an AI engineer is a plus, but no verified funding or traction data was found beyond one client testimonial.
notes: No verified funding. Aggregators (VCBacked, FundedIQ) disagree: a $500k pre-seed (June 2026) versus a $20M Series A; the Series A appears wrong and neither is recorded as a round. One aggregator names a different founder; the YC page was used. Other companies named Panacea exist. No shutdown or acquisition found in an outcome search.
